build_TargetRateCompressionModule: build a TargetRateCompressionModule with a HyperpriorAutoencoderBase model and target rate config for neural image compression
run_rate_loss: run the rate_loss method to compute bits-per-pixel and rate targeting loss from latent and hyper likelihoods
run_training_step: run a training step that optimizes both the model and quantile parameters with manual backward passes
run_test_step: run a test step that compresses and decompresses images then measures distortion loss and bpp
run_configure_optimizers: run configure_optimizers to instantiate model and auxiliary optimizers with learning rate schedulers via Hydra
